goalZh: 读懂一段写给司机的感谢留言,学会用 Thank you for… 和过去时写感谢
canDoZh: 能读懂并写一段简短的感谢留言:谢什么、当时的情况、对方哪里好

newItems.noteZh: h 不发音,读 /ˈɑːnɪst/,所以前面用 an:an honest driver;重音在前。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.zh: (回到西雅图后,磊在叫车应用里给那位司机打了五星,还写了感谢留言)谢谢你,卡洛斯!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Last week, I lost my phone in your car.
lines.zh: 上周,我把手机丢在了你的车上。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: But you found it and called my friend the next morning.
lines.zh: 可是你发现了手机,第二天一早就打电话给我朋友。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Then you drove to us with my phone.
lines.zh: 然后你开车把手机给我们送了过来。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: My phone has photos of my family in China.
lines.zh: 我的手机里有我在中国的家人的照片。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.zh: 那些照片对我来说太珍贵了。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: You were so kind and honest.

questions.explainZh: 开头写 Thank you, Carlos!,接着写 I lost my phone in your car.——卡洛斯就是那位司机。

questions.prompt: 为什么那部手机对磊很重要?
options: 里面有他在中国的家人的照片
questions.explainZh: My phone has photos of my family in China. I love those photos.

questions.prompt: 司机是什么时候联系的?
questions.explainZh: you found it and called my friend the next morning.(第二天一早就打电话给我朋友)

grammar.titleZh: 写感谢留言:Thank you for… / You were so kind.
grammar.bodyZh: 感谢留言一般写三件事:① 发生了什么,用过去时:I lost my phone in your car. / You found it and called my friend.;② 这件事对你有多重要:My phone has photos of my family.;③ 夸对方、再说一遍谢谢:You were so kind and honest. Thank you for your help!。Thank you for + 名词,谢的是对方做的事(第 7 单元学过 Thanks for asking.)。写给不太熟的人,开头直接写对方的名字,结尾写自己的名字就行。

examples.text: You were so kind and honest.
You found it and called my friend the next morning.
examples.zh: 你发现了手机,第二天一早就打电话给我朋友。
